content: स्वाहा .²1 An oblation or offering made to all gods indiscriminately. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the wife of {%Agni%}; स्वाहा चैव विभावसोः (पतिदेवता) <ls>Mb. 13. 146. 5</ls>. --{%ind.%} An exclamation used in offering oblations to the gods (with <ab>dat.</ab>); इन्द्राय स्वाहा; अग्नये स्वाहा <ab>&c.</ab>
